svg.text: Pool controller board: every module plugs in
Reads left to right: 12V plug → buck (5V) → ESP32 → MOSFET → valve. Radar plugs in along the bottom edge. Top view (parts side).
mounting tape under it holds it flat
Dot = joined. Lines crossing with no dot
Buses are bare wire on the underside.
Left and right swap: column 1 is now on the right. Grey = pins to solder. Rings = where a wire is soldered.
ESP32: two 15-pin female sockets. Solder them
with the ESP32 plugged in so the spacing matches.
Buck: male pins in its IN−/IN+ and OUT−/OUT+
Place the sockets where its pins actually land.
MOSFET: 2 male pins in J1 (PWM, GND) pointing
down, into a 2-pin socket. 12V and valve wires
go in its screw terminals. Mounting tape underneath.
Radar: two 2-pin 5 mm terminals clipped together.
Where a wire meets a pin, push it through the
hole next to the pin and join them underneath.
Keep the 5V and GND buses apart, no bridges.
one lost at each cut), 1 × 1x40 male header,
